title: Photonic inference processors for edge AI
text: We present photonic inference processors that accelerate matrix multiplications using silicon photonics. Optical AI accelerators reduce energy per operation compared with GPUs.

title: Optical AI accelerator demo
text: A startup demonstrated an optical AI accelerator for inference workloads. Photonic computing remains early-stage without mass-market leaders.

title: Graphene biosensors for home monitoring
text: Graphene biosensors enable continuous biomarker tracking at home. Microfluidic chips are combined with flexible electrodes.

title: Cloud computing in hospitals
text: Cloud computing platforms dominate hospital IT. This mature market has clear leaders and standards.
